_comment: Resources a native image must include, because nothing on the class path
is reachable at run time unless it is named here.
picocli-codegen generates the reflection config next door but knows only
about picocli's own resources, not this library's. These three are loaded
by name at run time: the message bundles behind every finding, and the
holiday data behind the V-5xx rules.
NativeImageResourcesTest fails the build when a runtime resource is not
matched here, which is what stops this file going stale.
